posts.name: The Burning Stickman
posts.cooked:
Still, though, the statement was no unlock to date required a character to do something they couldn't normally.

I really don't think there are hard and fast rules like that. We've seen a number of different combinations required. If I was to speculate, I'd say these unlocks are probably less complex than some in the past because of their relatively rapid-fire nature. Christopher and the game devs probably realize that if it's taking us weeks to figure out each of them, the whole thing's going to get bogged down and frustrating. Better to let them be simpler and let the excitement of the hunt get both rewarded with success and renewed each week.
